ja: 百鬼夜行図（改変版：AI 生成の動画を重ねたもの）
en: Hyakki Yagyō-zu (Night Parade of One Hundred Demons), modified: with AI-generated video layers

ja: 【AI 生成のコンテンツを含む改変版です】東京大学総合図書館が所蔵する絵巻『百鬼夜行図』の画像に、絵の一部を AI で動かした 8 秒の動画 19 本を、切り出した元の場所に重ねたマニフェストです。動画の動き・音・細部は AI が作ったもので、原資料に描かれたものでも、学術的な復元でもありません。原資料の画像そのものには手を加えておらず、東京大学の IIIF Image API から読み込んでいます。原資料の姿を確かめるときや研究の典拠には、動画を隠すか、原資料のマニフェストをご覧ください。IIIF Cookbook のレシピ 0036（複数の画像からの合成）と同じ形で、追加の画像の代わりに動画（Video）を、#xywh で Canvas の一部に描いています。Canvas には duration を持たせていません。各動画の summary には、動画を作るときに使った動きの指示文が入っています。
en: [A modified version that contains AI-generated content] The handscroll Hyakki Yagyō-zu, held by The University of Tokyo General Library, with 19 eight-second AI-generated clips placed back on the regions of the picture they were made from. The motion, sound and details of the clips were made by AI: they are not in the original, and they are not a scholarly reconstruction. The image of the original itself is not altered; it is loaded from the IIIF Image API of The University of Tokyo. To see the original as it is, or to cite it in research, hide the clips or use the original manifest. The manifest has the shape of IIIF Cookbook recipe 0036 (Composition from Multiple Images): each added resource is a Video, painted on a region of the Canvas with #xywh. The Canvas has no duration. The summary of each clip is the motion prompt used to generate it.

ja: (1) 原資料の画像から、人物・妖怪の描かれた範囲を切り出した。(2) 切り出した画像を始まりと終わりの両方のコマに指定し、動きの指示文とともに AI で 8 秒の動画を作った。(3) 縁は原資料の画素に置き換え、動いている所だけ動画を使い、ほかは原資料の画素のままにした（下の「後処理」）。(4) 切り出した元の範囲（#xywh）に重ねた。原資料の画像は変えていない。
en: (1) Regions with figures were cropped from the image of the original. (2) Each crop was given as both the start frame and the end frame, and turned into an 8-second clip by AI with a motion prompt. (3) The edge was replaced with the pixels of the original, and only the moving parts were taken from the video; everything else is the original pixels (see Post-processing). (4) The clips were painted back on the regions they were cropped from (#xywh). The image of the original is unchanged.

en: Post-processing

ja: 動画は、切り出した範囲に合わせて端を切り、色を原資料に合わせたうえで、二つの処理をしている。(a) 縁の帯（幅 24 画素、内側へ 96 画素でなじませる）は原資料の画素に置き換えた。(b) 動いている所だけ動画を使い、ほかは原資料の画素のままにした。動いている所は、ぼかした明るさが時間の中央値から 6 を超えてずれる画素を、24 画素広げ、32 画素でぼかして決めた（動画 1 本につき 1 枚の範囲）。そのため、止まっている紙や線は原資料のままで、ちらつかない
en: Each clip was trimmed to its region and colour-matched to the original, then two steps were applied. (a) A band at the edge (24 px, blended over 96 px inwards) is replaced with the pixels of the original. (b) Only the parts that move come from the video; everything else is the original pixels. The moving parts are the pixels whose blurred brightness deviates from the temporal median by more than 6, grown by 24 px and feathered by 32 px (one mask per clip). So the still paper and lines are the original and do not flicker

ja: AI（Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash、Google Flow）が生成した動画。原資料には無い。動きの指示文：カメラは固定し、ズームもパンもしない。これは日本の絵巻の、古びた紙に描かれた平面の絵である。紙の質感、色、筆線は、最も右の縦の紙継ぎも含めて、画像のまま変えない。画面内のどの人物も、クリップ全体を通して同じ人物のままである。人物が現れたり、消えたり、別の人物に変わったりせず、新しい物も加えない。各人物は顔、髪、衣服、位置を保ったまま、8秒間を通してはっきりと動き続け、その動きはひと目で分かる大きさである。動きは次のとおりである。最も左にいる、頭が赤い炎を上げる黒漆の壺で、体が藁の蓑になっている生き物は、藁の体を左右に揺らし、炎をちらちらと跳ねさせ、長い棒を前後に突き出す。胸に大きな目を持ち、濃い青の衣を着た白髪の鬼は、上げた脚を蹴り出し、腕を振り、目をぎょろつかせ、胸の目がまばたきする。中央の背の高い鳥頭の人物は、長く湾曲したくちばしを持ち、淡い青、白、ピンクの模様の衣を着ており、長い首を下げては上げ、くちばしを開閉し、かぎ爪のある片足を持ち上げる。右にいる緑の衣の人物は、赤い炎を上げる大きな黒い壺を背負い、背後に道具をぶら下げており、その場でよろめき、炎をちらちらと跳ねさせ、ぶら下がった道具を揺らす。最後のフレームは最初のフレームと同一である。
en: AI-generated clip (Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Google Flow), not part of the original. Motion prompt: Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan. This is a flat painting on aged paper from a Japanese handscroll; the paper texture, colors and brush lines stay exactly as in the image, including the vertical paper seam at the far right. Every figure in the picture stays the same figure for the whole clip; no figure appears, disappears, or turns into another figure, and no new object is added. Each figure keeps its face, hair, clothing and place, but moves clearly and continuously for the full 8 seconds, with motion large enough to see at a glance: the creature at the far left whose head is a black lacquered pot with red flames and whose body is a skirt of straw swishes its straw body from side to side, its flames flicker and leap, and it pokes its long stick forward and back; the grey-haired demon in a dark blue robe with a large eye on its bare chest kicks its raised leg, swings its arm, rolls its eyes and the eye on its chest blinks; the tall bird-headed figure in the center, with a long curved beak and a robe in pale blue, white and pink patterns, bobs its long neck down and up, opens and closes its beak, and lifts one clawed foot; the figure on the right in a green robe carrying a large black pot with red flames on its back, with tools hanging behind, staggers in place, its flames flicker and leap, and the hanging tools swing. The last frame is identical to the first frame.

This is a flat ink-and-color painting on aged paper from a Japanese handscroll; preserve the exact original thin ink outlines, muted mineral pigments, and paper texture without redrawing or thickening the lines. Every figure stays in its exact original place and posture, with only very slow, subtle, small-amplitude motion (no new objects, no disappearing or morphing figures): the grey shaggy beast at the far left breathes and slightly shifts its head; the grey horned creature behind it slightly nods and moves its jaw; the small blue-faced creature beside the chest gently tugs the rope; the red-faced goblin in the chest peeks slightly up and blinks, and the eyes under the chest blink; the tall thin ogre on the right slightly sways its head and hair, while the wooden chest stays completely still. The last frame is identical to the first frame.
